Noah CSM: AstraHealth onboarding handshake - align stakeholders, success metrics, timeline, and renewal risks. Quick sync Mon 11am PT?
Elena (AM): I can do Mon 11. Who from AstraHealth?
AstraHealth PM: I'll join (Priya) plus our lead eng (Liam) and privacy (Hannah).
Noah CSM: Draft agenda: pilot goals, traffic & model profile, SSO/KMS, cutover checklist, enablement/training, renewal checkpoints.
Vik Eng: Please post expected QPS and retention. Also flag any PII concerns.
AstraHealth PM: Target 3 req/s average, spikes to 25 req/s. No PII in prompts, only hashed IDs. KMS required.
Samir SE: Success criteria proposal: p95 latency <300ms, error rate <1%, two validated flows, docs + workshop completed. Missed checks -> remediation plan.
Elena (AM): Renewal checkpoint at day 45 post-prod. If metrics & ROI good, AM triggers procurement.
Noah CSM: I'll create shared success doc and post service account request template.
Noah CSM: Template:
Service account: astra-pilot-svc
Scopes: inference:invoke, logs:read
Expiry: 90d

integrations-bot: CI deploy scheduled: build astra-42 -> canary 10% on Sun 8pm PT. Link: https://ci.example/astra-42
Vik Eng: I'll prep sandbox pool and estimate burst capacity cost if >15 req/s sustained.
AstraHealth PM: Hannah will send KMS and compliance notes after this thread.
Noah CSM: Actions before Mon: 1) Astra send KMS/compliance (Hannah), 2) traffic and flow specs (Priya), 3) Vik confirm sandbox sizes, 4) Samir draft workshop outline, 5) Noah share success doc.
Elena (AM): I'll bring procurement scenarios to the sync.
Noah CSM: Thanks team. Meeting invite incoming. :calendar:
